rules.title: Insufficient Clearance for 24V/48V Traces
rules.threshold: Min 0.25mm for 24V, Min 0.50mm for 48V (Bare Board External)

rules.title: Split Ground Plane Under High-Speed Pairs
rules.threshold: Continuous reference plane required; zero slot/split crossings
rules.reference: High-Speed PCB Design Guidelines (Intel/TI Application Notes)

rules.title: Differential Pair Length Mismatch
rules.threshold: Intra-pair length difference must be < 0.5mm for USB 2.0 High-Speed (480 Mbps)

rules.title: Decoupling Capacitor Placement Distance
rules.threshold: Decoupling capacitor must be placed within 2.5mm of IC power pin with direct via to ground
rules.reference: STMicroelectronics AN4381 (Hardware Design Guide for STM32)
